$description: The Links — design tokens (DTCG). Hand-authored per the playbook intake.md §5 known manual step: no converter exists from the campaign brand-kit format. Evidence base: marketing/websites/the-links/brand-inventory.md. Rationale: marketing/websites/the-links/brand-direction.md. Compiled target: src/styles/tokens.css. Every ratio recorded here is a computed WCAG 2.1 contrast ratio, not an estimate.

com.monkeyjumplabs.meta.status: PROPOSAL — not client-approved. This is the input to a human gate.

palette.$description: Raw primitives. Nine values. Do not reference these directly in components — use `role.*`.

forest.$description: Deep forest green. RETAINED VERBATIM from the live theme, where it is declared as the theme black (--black-hsl: 149.47, 61.29%, 18.24%) and backs 66 sections. The brand's single strongest colour equity.

night.$description: NEW. A deeper forest for fields that sit against the interior photography (measured: 33–38% of every professional frame is near-black). Not a hue change — the same 150° hue, darker.

ember.$description: NEW. Hue 25°. The action colour. Derived from the venue's own warm pendant light (every measured frame is red-dominant over blue by +15 to +19) and loosely anchored to the orange #F49C4C already present in the LL Icon raster. Chosen at this exact darkness so white text clears AA both at rest and after the codebase's brightness-125 hover.

emberMid.$description: NEW. Focus and state ember. Border/ring use only — not a text-bearing fill.

emberTint.$description: NEW. Light warm field for callouts and the seasonal featured-offer block.

amber.$description: NEW. Hue 32°. The pendant light itself. DARK FIELDS ONLY — 1.85:1 on white.

greige.$description: RETAINED VERBATIM from the live theme (--lightAccent). Secondary light field; 54 sections use it today.

sage.$description: RETAINED VERBATIM from the live theme (--darkAccent), but DEMOTED. Squarespace serves it as a 'dark' section background with white text at 2.02:1 — a hard AA failure. It survives only as a light field carrying forest-green text.

screen.$description: NEW, but the surviving trace of the retired slate #7794A6 — same 203° hue family, darkened until white text passes. Justified by the one cool element in every frame of the photography: the simulator projection. Informational/status only, never action.

clay.$description: NEW. The only red in the system. Error and destructive states.

moss.$description: NEW. Success states. A brighter sibling of forest so success does not read as body text.

paper.$description: NEW. Barely-warm off-white. Reads as paper rather than screen beside the warm photography. Doubles as the 'white' text colour on every dark fill.

white.$description: RETAINED. The dominant background across 155 sections.

retired.$description: Values present in the live site that this direction removes. Recorded so nobody reintroduces them by accident.

slate.$description: RETIRED as the action colour. It is the de-facto colour of every button on all 41 pages, but only because Squarespace aliases --safeLightAccent and --safeDarkAccent to --accent — nobody chose it. White text on it is 3.20:1, which FAILS WCAG AA (4.5:1) sitewide. It is also the only cool colour in a measurably warm brand.

rogueGreen.$description: RETIRED. A hand-picked desaturated green on two homepage H4s — the site's only author-set literal hex. hsl(147°, 8%, 26%) against the brand's hsl(150°, 61%, 18%). Someone reached for the colour picker instead of the palette swatch.

iconOrange.$description: RETIRED as-is. Exists only inside one 600×600 PNG on one page. Its warmth is correct and is carried forward by palette.amber and palette.ember; the value itself is 2.16:1 on white and cannot carry text.

logoInk.$description: RETIRED. The ink of the old ornate 'Lakeville Links' lockup — the mark that still ships as the favicon and the Open Graph image on all 41 pages. It goes when those two assets are replaced.

role.$description: The semantic layer. Components reference ONLY these. Every pairing below carries its computed ratio and its WCAG verdict.

raised.$description: Cards, raised sections. ink on it 9.32:1 (AA ✓).

alt.$description: Alternating light band. ink on it 7.81:1 (AA ✓).

tintWarm.$description: Callout / featured offer. ink on it 7.62:1 (AA ✓).

tintCool.$description: Light decorative field. ink on it 5.01:1 (AA ✓). NEVER white text — 2.02:1 (FAIL).

dark.$description: The dark field. paper on it 9.32:1 (AA ✓), white 10.14:1, greige 7.81:1, sage 5.01:1, amber 5.49:1.

darkest.$description: Over/beside photography. white on it 13.57:1, greige 10.46:1, amber 7.35:1 (all AA ✓).

default.$description: Body and headings on light. on white 10.14:1, on paper 9.32:1, on greige 7.81:1 (AA ✓ everywhere).

muted.$description: Secondary text, captions, table meta. on white 6.89:1, on greige 5.31:1 (AA ✓). Use this instead of an opacity on ink — ink/70 over white computes to 4.39:1, which FAILS AA.

onDark.$description: Text on any dark field. on forest 9.32:1, on night 12.48:1 (AA ✓).

inverse.$description: Maximum-contrast text on dark. on forest 10.14:1 (AA ✓).

default.$description: THE ACTION COLOUR. Fill for every primary CTA. paper text on it 6.85:1, white text on it 7.45:1 (AA ✓). As a fill against white the boundary is 7.45:1 (non-text gate 3:1 ✓).

hover.$description: Explicit hover fill, equivalent to the codebase's brightness-125. paper text on it 4.91:1 (AA ✓ — the value of ember was chosen so this stays above 4.5).

onDarkField.$description: RULE, not a colour: a solid ember button on a forest or night field is 1.36:1 / 1.82:1 against its own background and FAILS the 3:1 non-text gate. It is mathematically impossible for one fill to carry white text at 4.5:1 AND clear 3:1 against a near-black green. On dark fields the CTA MUST invert to a paper fill with forest text (9.32:1) or use an outline in paper.

default.$description: Informational / status (e.g. a league's 'Full' badge). paper on it 6.89:1, white on it 7.49:1 (AA ✓).

highlight.$description: Warm highlight — rules, eyebrows, icon fills, stats. DARK FIELDS ONLY: on forest 5.49:1, on night 7.35:1 (AA ✓); on white 1.85:1 (FAIL — never).

focus.$description: Focus ring / focused border. vs paper 4.37:1, vs white 4.76:1, vs greige 3.66:1 — all clear the 3:1 non-text gate (WCAG 2.1 1.4.11). Must be a visible ring, never `outline: none`.

focusOnDark.$description: Focus ring on dark fields. vs forest 5.49:1, vs night 7.35:1 (non-text gate 3:1 ✓).

disabledInk.$description: Disabled label. on greige 4.64:1, on white 6.02:1 (AA ✓). WCAG 1.4.3 exempts inactive controls; we clear it anyway so a disabled 'Sold out' button is still readable.

error.$description: Error text and border on light. on white 7.19:1, on paper 6.61:1 (AA ✓). paper text on a clay fill 6.61:1 (AA ✓).

errorOnDark.$description: Error text on a forest field. 5.05:1 (AA ✓).

success.$description: Success text on light. on white 7.82:1, on greige 6.02:1 (AA ✓).

successOnDark.$description: Success text on a forest field. 6.80:1 (AA ✓).

display.$description: Headings and button labels. Replaces Alfa Slab One, which ships a single weight (400), has no italic, and closes its counters below roughly 24px — the live site sets it at h4 1.4rem. Bitter keeps the slab genus so the change reads as a correction, not a new brand, and is a variable font (300–800) so the whole heading ladder plus button labels come from one file. NOTE: in this codebase the display face is bound to the `--brand-font-mono` slot, because global.css maps that slot to `font-mono`, which is what every heading and button uses. It is not a monospace slot.

body.$description: Body, navigation, forms, tables. RETAINED from the live site — it works, it is on all 41 pages, and the brand's warmth budget is better spent on the display face and the photography. Trimmed from 5 weights + 3 italics to 400/600/700 + one italic.

retired.$description: Alfa Slab One survives only inside the drawn wordmark. Poppins 500 is deleted outright: it is loaded on all 41 pages to set exactly one element, the header BOOK NOW! button.

fontLoading.$description: Self-hosted from public/fonts/. No external CDN request at any point — the live site's fonts are already self-hosted by Squarespace and that property is preserved. font-display: swap on every face, so the HTML paints before the fonts land and stays crawlable. Latin critical path: 34 KB display + 43 KB body = 77 KB across two files. Latin-ext and italic are separate unicode-range slices and are fetched only if a page needs them.
